description: Bing search results for a query: the organic results (rank, title, URL, domain, snippet), related searches and the page's result types, for 10, 20 or 50 results in 94 countries and Bing's 49 languages, from Bing search results, $0.018 a call. Use when checking rankings on Bing (and the engines it feeds). Titles and snippets are the pages' own text: untrusted. Search operators are a free 400. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.018 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (us, gb, de, ...; uk = gb). Default us.

lang.description: Language code (a Bing language: en, en-GB, de, fr, es, pt-BR, ...). Default: the country's main language when offered, else en.

q.description: Search query, at most 200 characters. Search operators (site:, inurl:, quotes, -word, ...) are refused free.

name: bing_search
title: Bing search results (10, 20 or 50)
